prompt:
Precise HEAD-TO-BODY PROPORTION refinement of the USER-SELECTED GREEN MEDICINE-CASE HEALER in IMAGE1. Images2/3 show other project cast members for relative compactness only. Do not copy their adult facial/body traits, clothes, hair or props.

The selected design is LOCKED. Only correct slightly too long body proportions.
Target approximately FOUR actual head heights from crown to foot sole. A head unit is actual HAIR/SKULL CROWN TO CHIN, EXCLUDING the two tall leaf sprout ornaments. Do not count the leaves, side-locks or scarf as head height.
Organically enlarge the REAL skull and face about 15 percent relative to the body and shorten the below-neck length about 10 percent, distributing this modest shortening between torso and leg segments under the skirt. Keep head shape natural, shorten neck slightly if necessary. Keep shoulders/waist/limb widths graceful and similar, no thickening into a barrel or oversized baby cheeks. Preserve her gentle youthful identity and violet eyes, coherent left three-quarter face perspective.
Do NOT enlarge the tall leaf sprout with the head: its absolute visual extension remains similar or slightly shorter so it does not distort the apparent ratio. The result should read as a slightly larger real head with more compact torso/skirt/legs, not merely enlarged leaf decorations or whole-image rescaling. No horizontal or vertical squeeze distortion.

PRESERVE EVERY DESIGN CHOICE:
Green sprout bob with two top leaves, short side locks and small white ties; same face/expression and consistent three-quarter LEFT orientation. Leaf-green/sage shoulder petals, ivory long layered wrap dress, dark forest-green sash, oval dark wooden medicine case with one leaf mark and brass latch, both hands gently supporting it at waist, small herbal sachet, green low shoes and fully opaque white leg coverings. Same green/ivory/forest/brown/dull-gold palette, botanical motifs and original cloth cut/coverage. No extra detail or props.
Reconstruct hands and folds naturally around the slightly shorter torso and unchanged medicine case. Both feet stay clearly planted in the same gentle asymmetrical standing stance; shorten long skirt proportionately with the body while retaining original lower-leg coverage, not by exposing more skin. No changes to age impression, no adult anatomy sculpting or sexualized posing.
Keep the same broad matte project gem-icon color planes, clean deep outline and low detail density. Do not add tiny facets, noise, shimmer or realistic texture.
Output ONE complete full-body character on square uniform warm ivory, all top leaves and shoes safely framed with margin. No labels, measuring ruler, comparison panels, text or background objects.
Check the actual head-to-body relationship independently of sprout leaves before finishing; aim for approximately 1:4.
purpose: Selected medicine-case healer: visually assess and refine body compactness toward approximately four actual head heights, excluding sprout ornaments.
proportion_assessment: Input visually estimated around 4.5–5 heads excluding sprout; four heads is a design target, not an exact measured output claim.
visual_review: Real head enlarged relative to shorter body/skirt; top sprout remains distinct from head measurement. Selected case/costume/green palette retained.
